basis: Each company's latest full fiscal year, in $ million. Revenue, EBITDA margin (operating profit before depreciation as a share of revenue) and net margin (net profit as a share of revenue) are that year's; return on capital employed (ROCE) is the latest reported. Consolidated accounts where the company files them. Banks and lenders have no EBITDA margin or ROCE.

chain.line: Median EBITDA margin by layer: Fabless chip design 7.0% (28 of 37 companies); Semiconductor equipment 18.3% (10 of 11 companies); Analog and power integrated device makers 12.9% (13 of 14 companies). Stock-based pay differs 4.7 times between these layers (Semiconductor equipment 2.1% of revenue, Fabless chip design 10.2%), and an EBITDA margin counts it as a cost, so they are not ranked on it.
